findings.statement: Two literal keyword searches returned 150 and 12 unique FY2026-window prime contract awards; all 12 occur within the 150.
findings.inference_limit: Query behavior is not a literal legal-name suffix filter or a count of fraudulent records.

findings.statement: Six broad-query recipient profiles represent three exact UEIs, each at P and C profile levels.
findings.inference_limit: These are three source identifiers, not six companies or a verified count of ultimate legal entities.

findings.statement: The two AWS names differ by terminal punctuation and have different reported UEIs and VA/WA profile states.
findings.inference_limit: No automatic merge; punctuation and multiple identifiers do not establish a counterfeit company.

findings.statement: All three child-level profiles report parent UEI G5F2C46HBCM3, labelled AMAZON.COM, INC.
findings.inference_limit: A reported common parent is a consistency check, not independently authenticated beneficial ownership or exoneration.

findings.statement: The three parent-level profiles report self-parent identifiers; profile level changes parent-field interpretation.
findings.inference_limit: Do not use a P-level self-parent as an ultimate-control finding or sum P/C amounts.

findings.statement: The broad award capture has 150 unique award identifiers, three raw recipient names, three UEIs and no missing UEIs.
findings.inference_limit: Coverage applies only to selected code types, date window and keyword; not all vendor aliases or spending.

findings.statement: No same-UEI multiple-name variation was observed in the six profiles and 150 award records.
findings.inference_limit: A null result within one bounded query cannot establish absence of aliases or impersonation elsewhere.

findings.statement: Recipient profile amounts use a trailing-12-month transaction basis; award-search amounts have a different award-level basis.
findings.inference_limit: No monetary sums, losses, savings or reward calculations are produced.

findings.statement: SAM permits an entity to obtain a UEI without completing registration.
findings.inference_limit: A UEI is not proof of current active registration, historical eligibility or absence of exclusion.

findings.statement: The captured dot query includes eleven Amazon.com Services awards and one AWS award with no terminal period in its displayed name.
findings.inference_limit: The search input must not be mistaken for a literal punctuation-only population.
